notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: Art Style Poll for Re-Impregnation DLC
notes.content:
[b]EDIT: The fans have spoken! We will be sticking with the OLD Semi-Realistic art style. Thank you for taking the time to comment and voting![/b]

We would like your feedback on whether or not we should use a [b]NEW Cell Shading style[/b] for the [b]Prince of Suburbia Re-Impregnation DLC.
[/b]
If you didn't already know, [b]Auxiliaryout[/b] is back and will be working on the [b]Prince of Suburbia Re-Impregnation DLC[/b]. We're thinking about using [b]auxiliaryout's New Cell Shading style[/b] (like he has been using for his game, [b]Her Last Piece[/b]).

Below is a comparison for [b]Catherine[/b]. [b]The NEW Cell Shading style[/b] is on the left (post-pregnancy) and the [b]OLD Semi-Realistic style[/b] is on the right (pre-pregnancy).

[b]NOTE: The "thicker" post-pregnancy look will be applied to characters for the OLD Semi-Realistic style sprites if we keep it too. It's not exclusive to the new style.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/ecae8b00d1f69b7df8a8637891f4da2a066eeebe.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/2c3af449fa5ac1275e92393f71991634834b8836.jpg[/img]

[b]Pros: [/b]

[list]
[*] Faster than the style currently used in the main story of PoS
[*] Doesn't require as much time to ramp back up on the original style that was used which would delay the DLC development
[*] It's novel and more fun for us. This is a style that we hope/plan to use for future 2D games as well so it would be nice to keep on with it
[/list]

[b] Neutral: [/b]

[list]
[*] Style has already changed with the Pregnancy DLC so things will be a little different regardless for the remaining DLC
[/list]

[b] Cons: [/b]

[list]
[*] Lack of 100% consistency from the main story art
[/list]

Please let us know with voting on this [b]POLL[/b]: [b]([url=https://strawpoll.com/LVyK26LXKZ0]STRAW POLL HERE[/url])[/b]

and in the comments if you like the [b]NEW Cell Shading style[/b] or would rather keep the [b]OLD Semi-Realistic style[/b] for the [b]Prince of Suburbia Re-Impregnation DLC.[/b]

notes.title: V1.0 update has released!
notes.content:
[h1]The V1.0 update is now available![/h1]
The update has been made to both [b]Part 1[/b] and [b]Part 2[/b] of [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i]. Thank you to all of you that entered our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1896170/announcements/detail/3799410647390921666?snr=2_9_100003_]Global Steam Key Giveaway[/url]! Winners will be contacted by DM on Steam today.

[h1]Note: Saves will be broken.[/h1]
[quote][b]V1.0[/b] is a game-breaking update. We made major changes to the code with this update, including brand new GUI and upgrading to Ren'Py 8+. If your saves are broken, clicking Start in the main menu will give you a few options for different jump in points so you don't have to start from the beginning.

Using old saves, even if they open without error, may cause errors later on. Please consider starting a new game or use one of the jump in points in the title menu rather than opening old saves.[/quote]
If you have any other trouble accessing the game or encounter any bugs or issues, please let us know!

The final update ([b]V1.0[/b]) of [b]Prince of Suburbia[/b] includes:

[h3]NEW CONTENT:[/h3][list]
[*] ~20,000 words
[*] 39 illustrations
[*] 23 animations
[*] 33 voice acting files (thanks to HaruLuna)
[/list]
[h3]REMASTERED CONTENT:[/h3][list]
[*] 16 illustrations
[*] 8 animations
[*] 115 voice acting files (thanks to HaruLuna)
[*] brand new GUI (thanks to m. of Tsundere Studio)
[/list]
[h3]THANK YOU to everyone who helped with this update:[/h3][list]
[*] m. of Tsundere Studio for the brand spanking new GUI
[*] auxiliaryout, for all the art and animations
[*] HaruLuna, for the amazing voice acting
[*] Rachel Writes and Yvlan_Angel for their writing help
[*] Our play testers for this update: Doc62, EDHPlayer, Hondo, NeverAtone, Saniya
[*] All of the generous volunteers who helped improve the translated and localized versions
[/list]
[h1]What's next for Prince of Suburbia?[/h1]
[b]V1.0[/b] completes [b]Part 2[/b] and the main story of [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i]. We want to make sure there are no major bugs or issues in the game (especially in the translated/localized versions) before we leave Early Access on Steam, but that is our next goal. The plan is to work on that in early 2024.

After [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] has left Early Access on Steam in early 2024, we will begin development on the additional [b]Pregnancy DLC[/b] content. Stay tuned for more on that next year!

notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: V1.0 Update + Dev Log
notes.content:
[h1]V1.0 is almost here![/h1]
We're thrilled to announce that the [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] V1.0[/b] update is almost here, with the base (English-only) version scheduled to be completed this month! The much-anticipated Steam release will follow about a month later, in November, when the translated and localized versions are complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/15b0c4ce0dba99ec164184edb6ec4d454dd4dc92.png[/img]
[h1]New and remastered content[/h1]
[b]V1.0[/b] is a significant update, featuring the most extensive free roam content we've ever included in the game. We hope that this update will be a satisfying ending to the [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] story!

[b]V1.0[/b] features animated scenes for all main love interests. We're also revisiting characters who haven't been in the spotlight for a while, such as [b]Naomi[/b], [b]Heather[/b], and [b]Lina[/b] (both versions have different art this update), each with their own animated scenes.

In addition to all the exciting new content, we've also remastered earlier parts of the game during this update cycle. This includes remastered animated lewd scenes with [b]Sarah[/b], [b]Heather[/b], and [b]Naomi[/b], as well as some remastered story illustrations.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/c9e2fada84eb05b380556a4ae86c7e9e2ec90377.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/5d1d6803cef4d07ce41467fc1406e9dc778fdb29.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/bdf8cd7c826ad822457802653a4051eba82a2d1e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/5031b9e5e7734e8337bd937e60d08a72248d5ce1.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/1f1c7d21aa0080453829946001e61dd3c55008dd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/3dac659ab60c7839db617d614f4b3011f6a30422.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/3efa5183af53bf484a187ed2a4c17d04290f8786.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/b3863fbe08f2a9aa218106b67d21097dd9acb78a.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/f0041d9626afb70d1f8879dda1c2eb30b5d81088.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/c33b424db4c786c3aad087ff9acfc09280b7fda0.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Voice Acting by HaruLuna[/h1]
We are delighted to announce that the talented [b]HaruLuna[/b] has provided voice acting for all of the scenes from earlier in the game that didn't already have voice acting. This update includes nearly 150 voice acting files, including the voice acting for the new content.

[h1]Revamped GUI[/h1]
One of the most notable changes in [b]V1.0[/b] is a complete overhaul of the game's GUI (Graphical User Interface). The entire interface has been redesigned, giving [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] a fresh and modern look. You can learn more about the redesign and see a preview video of the changes in [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/prince-of-dev-23-89724700]this public Patreon post.[/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/5c985d700d7f4852745b007e2f3a786fd6982eef.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/04e0ca3cd7a591f4774e383cce3ff7c08b610057.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/dd7622e9c9a7789c35643f2cd08f5681a6865f66.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/58acd3f879297773c1501d40f0d9ea26999a4bcc.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/e56dd65cc5e49a6d5d934086aba7002c26302e1b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/00de0af25f1e6797c3459fba517d5414cc4cca38.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/617d4776d0464de481f479f97cf90a7fb28403f6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/42ff5c65416db1abf038105dabe4160f22151eb0.png[/img][/url] 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/510c55f2eb9cfb1cb2eaca8aff25fb1e7ca35f48.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/bbb012b4f26578b3ff7d6ef3be29f1ba6a60433b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/8a7a41f2c67aebce4acabe24e971376c3323f6cd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/e1f296e2a0237a0c1844f79879e3da2f0010cd26.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/e0de2e795f816ac9d11d86e166a462d9003658a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/f32f4301959309206420488869e3f9065e74035d.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/2eccb0f43eaaeafc93c4f68f4604e528b9b45687.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/6ba9689806019d2401121db8632f1a9576c586d5.png[/img][/url] 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/660987e5c6ea7ff6dbcc07ec72973fb9d277ff01.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/5a9c4963e25e670c34a95e486c88e02a932cb189.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/1dae7a018db09b2ee3fcdace75c6f617d0f1da98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/191478f921378f9ca2aec4b388422a4de2d4584c.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/ea291e43a611eb2c5ac6830afb15e6e08c61576d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/fa5fd5815470bb4fb961003bbbff92d395e95d44.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/9a54a4e018ca47654e2b1107afea33fdeda65960.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/127ef4a8fa95e5514b554ecdde4e698ab3a62466.png[/img][/url]

We are thankful for the incredible work of [b]m.[/b] from [b]Tsundere Studio[/b] for their GUI expertise. Be sure to check out their game, [i][b]I Just Want to be Single!![/b][/i], available for wishlist on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1703610/I_Just_Want_to_be_Single/

[h1]Upcoming Pregnancy DLC[/h1]
We want to thank our community for their valuable input regarding the [b]Pregnancy DLC[/b] that we will be working on more extensively once [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] V1.0[/b] is released. We're currently running polls for $5+ supporters on [url=https://www.patreon.com/ViMStudios]Patreon[/url] and [url=https://subscribestar.adult/vimstudios]SubscribeStar[/url], so be sure to check them out if you haven't already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/e1b0486933135c2c8e94c2ed7512dd6bbed5f462.png[/img]

[h1]October 2023 Calendar Wallpapers[/h1]
In the spirit of the spooky season, we've also prepared some special wallpapers featuring [b]Catherine[/b] and [b]Sarah[/b]. $3+ supporters can grab these wallpapers on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/ViMStudios]Patreon[/url] and [url=https://subscribestar.adult/vimstudios]SubscribeStar[/url] pages.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/f75bde8ed8f46ab79f869f19b1929c6f3a4adfdb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/06806d03a0b6d8f918221269a3c485b61e9ea56d.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/b44a8bfde1710f6bb44af4d94ba4f9941a5c8441.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/dafd2f9d1434d144ab1a9cc06bc37acc6e9ef3c1.png[/img][/url]

[h1]What's Next for Prince of Suburbia[/h1]
To hear more about our plans for [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] and beyond, be sure to listen to this episode of our [b]Seedy AF Podcast[/b]:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k4Jmx226Xpc

As always, we appreciate your continued support and patience as we approach the end of our [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] journey!

notes.title: Free Update (V0.95) to Part 1 & Part 2!
notes.content:
A [u][b]FREE UPDATE[/b][/u] has been made to both [b]Part 1 (FREE DEMO)[/b] and [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b] of [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] with remastered scenes, new content, and improved translations! Watch the [b]V0.95[/b] trailer on YouTube for a preview of what's new in this update!

[previewyoutube=JbUT6l_5ml0;full][/previewyoutube]
The [b]V0.95[/b] update adds new content to both [b]Part 1[/b] and [b]Part 2[/b]:[list]
[*] [b]Part 1[/b] receives 5 remastered scenes, including 8 illustrations and 7 animations.
[*] [b]Part 2[/b] receives 6 brand new scenes, including 19,000 words of dialogue, 2 backgrounds, 55 illustrations, and 37 animations.
[*] The remastered content added to [b]Part 1[/b] will be available to access directly from the gallery if you have already unlocked those scenes (you will not need to replay any scenes you've already played). The new content added to [b]Part 2[/b] is a free update for anyone who has purchased the DLC.
[*] All of the animations in this update include voiced acted moans and sex noises by our talented voice actress, [b]HaruLuna[/b]![/list][i]Notes:[/i][list]
[*] [i]If you encounter issues opening old saves, try starting a new game, or using the entry points in the main menu to start at the beginning of [b]Part 2[/b] or the [b]V0.95[/b] update. Save integrity is not guaranteed with each update, as the game is still in development. We also can't guarantee prior settings will be saved when making major updates to the game. These are known issues with the Ren'Py engine that are beyond our control.[/i]
[*] [i]If you encounter bugs unrelated to opening old saves, or if you have purchased the [b]Part 2 DLC[/b] and have any issues accessing the new content, please reach out to us as well. We are happy to help![/i]
[*] [i]If you downloaded V0.95 from Patreon or SubscribeStar, there is no new content in the Steam version. All that was added is the translations to other languages.[/i][/list]We've also made big improvements to the translated versions of the game, thanks to the generous work of our volunteers. We currently support, and have improved the translations for:  Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Italian, Polish, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese, and Russian.

We are excited to announce that we are adding Turkish support with the [b]V0.95[/b] update! We also currently have a volunteer working on a Ukrainian translation that we hope to include with the next ([b]V1.0[/b]) update. If you are interested in helping with the translation process, [url=https://discord.com/invite/7BtkMQCRmV]please reach out to us on Discord[/url]!

For more updates about the development of [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i], [url=https://www.patreon.com/ViMStudios]follow us on Patreon[/url]!

notes.title: V0.95 Update Release Date & Other News
notes.content:
[h1]V0.95 STEAM RELEASE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/7cc9822cbd81d90042009f59b0cebb6b3e2ea2bb.png[/img]
The latest ([b]V0.95[/b]) update of [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] will launch on Steam on [b]Monday, August 7[/b]! We can't wait for our fans and players on Steam to see the improvements we've made and the new content we've added.

The [b]V0.95[/b] update includes remastered art in [b]Part 1[/b], including 8 illustrations and 7 animations, while [b]Part 2[/b] receives 6 new scenes, with about 19K words of dialogue, 2 backgrounds, 55 illustrations, and 37 animations. All animations in this update feature voiced acted moans and sex noises by the talented [b]HaruLuna[/b]!

[i]Notes:[/i][list]
[*] [i]If you encounter issues opening old saves, try starting a new game, or using the entry points in the main menu to start at the beginning of [b]Part 2[/b] or the [b]V0.95[/b] update. Save integrity is not guaranteed with each update, as the game is still in development. We also can't guarantee prior settings will be saved when making major updates to the game. These are known issues with the Ren'Py engine that are beyond our control.[/i]
[*] [i]If you encounter bugs unrelated to opening old saves, or if you have purchased the [b]Part 2 DLC[/b] and have any issues accessing the new content, please reach out to us as well. We are happy to help![/i]
[*] [i]If you downloaded V0.95 from Patreon or SubscribeStar, there is no new content in the Steam version. All that was added is the translations to other languages.[/i][/list][h1]IMPROVED TRANSLATIONS[/h1]
We've made big improvements to the translated versions of the game, thanks to the generous work of our volunteers. We currently support, and have improved the translations for: English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Italian, Polish, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese, and Russian.

We are excited to announce that we are adding Turkish support with the [b]V0.95[/b] update! We also currently have a volunteer working on a Ukrainian translation that we hope to include with the next ([b]V1.0[/b]) update. If you are interested in helping with the translation process, [url=https://discord.com/invite/7BtkMQCRmV]please reach out to us on Discord[/url]!

[h1]NEW DISCOUNTED BUNDLE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/4aa4856a8bbb0463bf5f3a9d821e32ca33a7c985.png[/img]
We're excited to announce that [b]ViM Studios[/b] and [b]Whiteleaf Studios[/b] have partnered together to bring you the [b]"Sweet Home Alabama"[/b] bundle on Steam! If you like linear visual novels with beautiful art, plenty of "family love," and tons of impregnation and lactation, you will love [i][b]Tamas Awakening[/b][/i]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34001/Sweet_Home_Alabama/

You can now buy [i][b]Tamas Awakening[/b][/i] at a discounted price when you buy [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] - Part 2[/b]! If you have already purchased [b]Part 2[/b], you can still get the discount on [i][b]Tamas Awakening[/b][/i] with this bundle.

[h1]FUTURE DEVELOPMENT[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/64be44187812714c95af91d0bb3dbd60875499bc.png[/img]
The last update to the main story ([b]V1.0[/b]) of [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] is currently in development with an estimated release of Fall 2023. For more details and art previews, check out our previous dev log: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1896170/view/3656411207742195432?l=english]Prince of Suburbia: July Dev Log, Progress Updates & Previews[/url]

notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: V0.95 Updates + Summer Sale
notes.content:
[h2]Testing has started for V0.95![/h2]
We're thrilled to announce that testing has begun for the highly anticipated [b]V0.95[/b] update to [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i][/b]! This update represents our most ambitious work yet, and we can't wait for you to experience it. We hope you are prepared to have your mind blown as you blow your load! :D

The [b]V0.95[/b] update will add new content to both [b]Part 1 (free)[/b] and [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b]:[list]
[*] [b]Part 1[/b] will receive 5 remastered scenes, including 8 illustrations and 7 animations. 
[*] [b]Part 2[/b] will receive 6 brand new scenes, including 19,000 words of dialogue, 2 backgrounds, 55 illustrations, and 37 animations. 
[*] All of the animations in this update include voiced acted moans and sex noises by our talented voice actress, [b]HaruLuna[/b]!
[/list]We will announce the official release date as soon as it is confirmed. Stay tuned for more details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/8e1f73d62c6a2300dd9e9a1ca285c6de27be2135.png[/img]

[h2]Preparing V0.95 for Steam release[/h2]
Once the final testing phase is complete, we will begin preparing the builds for Steam, including all the additional languages we support (Spanish, Italian, Polish, Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese). Creating all the localized versions requires a few extra weeks of coding and testing.

We appreciate your patience with the localization process! As always, we will keep players updated as we have more details on the timeline for release on Steam.

[h2]Summer Sale on Steam[/h2]
Don't miss out on the current Summer Sale! [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] - Part 2 (V0.9)[/b] is currently available at a discounted price of 20% off. This is your last chance to purchase [b]Part 2[/b] at a reduced price before the [b]V0.95[/b] update is added to the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/ca131ed18905e5204f33e3854740a5a5ffaa6954.png[/img]

Thank you for your ongoing support and patience. We can't wait to show you all the exciting new content we've been working on!

notes.title: Prince of Suburbia: March Dev Log, Progress Update & Previews
notes.content:
[h2]Part 2 (paid DLC) currently on sale until April 3![/h2]
The [b]Spring Sale[/b] has been extended! You can still purchase [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2149280/Prince_of_Suburbia__Part_2/][b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] - Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b][/url] for [b]10% off through April 3[/b]. Buy it today!

[h2]Frequently asked questions[/h2]
Here are some questions we get frequently from our players on Steam!

[h3]What updates are planned for Part 2 (paid DLC)?[/h3]
[list][*] The [b]first beach update (V0.9)[/b] was already added to the game last month. This update was free for all players who had previously purchased the [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b].
[*] The [b]second beach update (V0.95)[/b] will be the second free update to the [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b]. It will also be free for all players who have previously purchased the [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b]. It's estimated release on Steam is late Spring 2023.
[*] The [b]last update to the main story (V1.0)[/b] will be the last free update made to the [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b]. It is estimated to release in the second half of 2023 and will be free for all players who have previously purchased the [b]Part 2 DLC[/b].[/list][h3]When will the game leave Early Access? Will the price increase?[/h3]
Once all of the remastered art and voice acting has been added to both [b]Part 1 (free demo)[/b] and [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b], the game will move from [b]Early Access[/b] to full release. Our plan is for the game to leave [b]Early Access[/b] later in 2023.

A price increase for [b]Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b] will likely happen at this point, more details to follow as we approach this transition. 

[h3]Are there any plans for a Part 3?[/h3]
After we wrap up the main story with the [b]V1.0[/b] release, we plan to have [b]additional DLC content[/b] with all of the characters, including pregnancy content. These DLCs will not continue the main story, they will be standalone scenes that take place outside of the main story. [u]No Part 3 of the main story is planned.[/u] 

Stay tuned for more information about additional DLCs later in 2023!

[h2]Progress continues on the second beach update![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41933226/e838049f6b682f00d5b19a4a47c7e4fc030141a7.png[/img]

Art for the [b]second beach update (V0.95)[/b] of [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i] - Part 2 (paid DLC)[/b] is progressing on schedule! 

With the writing wrapping up for the next update of our other game, [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1853830/A_Shot_in_the_Dark/]A Shot in the Dark[/url][/b][/i], our team will be able to shift focus to [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] so we should see more progress on the writing in April. We are also looking to hire an additional writer or two to potentially help with this and/or future updates.

One of our team members who works on [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] has had a health emergency and will be taking the month of April off. If this causes any delays with the [b]V0.95[/b] development cycle, we will keep players updated. We did not anticipate releasing [b]V0.95[/b] in April anyway, so it's too soon to say if there will be an impact beyond that. We wish our team member a healthy and speedy recovery!

We are already planning ahead for the artwork and remastered scenes in [b]V1.0[/b] (the last update of the main story). Ideally, we'd like to get ahead on art so that our artist and animator can take a much-needed break to rest and heal his hand between the main game and the pregnancy/epilogue content we have planned for later this year or early next year.

If there are any delays with the release of [b]V0.95[/b], a silver lining is that it will likely allow us to include some of the remastered art planned for [b]V1.0[/b] in the [b]V0.95[/b] release so that we can sooner reach our goal of a fully remastered game and moving out of [b]Early Access[/b]!

The [b]V0.95[/b] update includes the most complex art we've ever attempted, and we are certain it will be worth the wait! Attached to this post are some previews to whet your appetite. ;)

For more updates about the development of [b][i]Prince of Suburbia[/i][/b], [url=https://discord.com/invite/7BtkMQCRmV]join us on [b]Discord[/b][/url] or [url=https://vim-studios.web.app/]check out our [b]website[/b][/url].

notes.content:
We have now updated the current [b]FREE DEMO (Part 1 - V0.55)[/b] of [i][b]Prince of Suburbia[/b][/i] with [b]more remastered art and Polish translation[/b] for [u][b]FREE[/b][/u] on all platforms where it is currently available, including here on Steam.

Thank you to those who helped with translation for this update!

We are working on improving our translation pipeline to allow for even more translations in the future. So, hopefully, we will have more announcements about that in the future!
